name: OpenCanvas
description: Collaborative canvases in channels: notes, databases and whiteboards, edited live. Files are stored in Mattermost.

settings_schema.header: Connect Mattermost to an OpenCanvas server. Register this server in OpenCanvas hosts.toml with the same host id, shared secret and API key (see the plugin README).

settings.help_text: Public address of the OpenCanvas server that browsers open, for example https://canvas.example.com
Where the Mattermost server calls OpenCanvas (access changes). Leave empty to use the OpenCanvas URL.
The id of this server's [[host]] entry in OpenCanvas hosts.toml.
HS256 secret for launch tokens and for verifying OpenCanvas callbacks (hosts.toml jwt_secret). At least 32 characters, for example the output of: openssl rand -hex 32
Only if hosts.toml sets a separate callback_secret. Leave empty to verify callbacks with the shared secret.
hosts.toml api_key. Used to end a person's access at once when they leave a channel.
What guest accounts that are members of a channel may do in its canvases.
How long a launch token stays valid before it is exchanged for a session (1 to 60).
